wikipedia.title: Cuddalore
wikipedia.text:
Cuddalore, also spelt as Kadalur ( ), is a heavy industries hub, port city, and headquarters of the Cuddalore District in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. Situated 5.3 km south of Puducherry (union territory), the city was an important port city  during the British Raj. Cuddalore district is famous for Pichavaram Mangrove Forest.
While the early history of Cuddalore remains unclear, the city first rose to prominence during the Pallavas' and Medieval Cholas' reign. After the fall of the Cholas, the town was ruled by various dynasties like Pandyas, Vijayanagar Empire, Madurai Nayaks, Thanjavur Nayaks, Thanjavur Marathas, Tipu Sultan, the French and the British Empire. Cuddalore was also a theatre of conflict in the Seven Years' War, witnessing the Battle of Cuddalore in 1758 between the French and British. It has been a part of independent India since 1947. During the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami, Cuddalore was one of the affected towns, with 572 recorded casualties.

wikipedia.title: Thimmanayakanpalayam
wikipedia.text: Thimmanayakanpalayam also known as T.N. Palayam is a panchayat village in Ariyankuppam Commune in the Union Territory of Puducherry.  It is also a revenue village under Ariyankuppam Firka

wikipedia.title: Kirumampakkam
wikipedia.text: Kirumampakkam is a village in Bahour Commune of Bahour taluk  in the Union Territory of Puducherry, India. It lies on Cuddalore road (NH-45A) at a distance of 15 km from Pondicherry.

wikivoyage.title: Cuddalore
wikivoyage.text:
Cuddalore (கடலூர் Kaṭalur) is a town at the central coast of Tamil Nadu. Cuddalore is a beautiful town located along the Bay of Bengal which is home to the famous Silver Beach.


== See ==

1 Cuddalore Government Museum. The collection represents the history, culture, flora and fauna of the district. Natural History specimens include South Indian timbers, fibres, swans, bears, lizards and snakes. Wood fossils and ammonite fossils are also on display. A sculpture garden in the museum welcomes visitors. In this sculpture garden Sivalinga, Nandhi, Vishnu, monkey sculptures, Narashima, Surya and Chandikeswara are displayed. The development of Tamil script, a dinosaur model and a model of Kali sculpture made of Fibreglass are kept at the entrance of the building. (updated Jun 2023)
2 Fort St. David. A ruined British fort. (updated Jun 2023)
3 Mulanathaswami Temple.  (updated Jun 2023)
4 Pataleeswarar Temple (பாடலீஸ்வரர் கோயில்), Thirupapuliyur. A Shiva temple of Pallava and Chola periods. 
5 Silver Beach. 2nd largest beach in Asia. (updated May 2026)
Hayagrivar Sannadhi - located in a small hillock nearby, this temple is well-known.
Sri Devanathan - Five kilometres from the main bus stand is the town Thiruvahindrapuram where this famous Vaishnavite temple is located.
Thiruvanthipuram Temple - Next famous to Tirupathi temple. Thiruvahindrapuram is one of the famous 108 Vaishnavite temples in India. There is also a temple for Veera Anjaneyar very close to


== Do ==
Visit these temples and you can also go to the beautiful and serene beach at Thevanampattinam, 4 km away. Near Cuddalore Old Town you can also find a minor port. There is a fishing harbour in Old Town.
Don't miss the "Paadaleswarar Temple", "Devanadha Swamy Temple" and "Sri Veera Anjaneya Swami" Temple - near to Bus stand and railway station - Thirupapuliyur. Also You can visit the " Sri Pidari Amman Temple" adjacent to the Brahannayaki Temple - Both these 2 temples are very close to the bus stand / Railway Station.
The beautiful Manavala Mamunigal sannidhi is located in Thiruvaheendrapuram.


== Eat ==
A good number of hotels and lodges are here. South Indian and North Indian food are available in these hotels.
There are good number of hotels available near Cuddalore Bus Stand and the Railway station. Cuddalore is one of the places where you can get the authentic South Indian food.
Be warned : All the hotels serve full meals only till 4 PM ! You can not get tiffin like Idli, dosai etc till after 4-30 PM
